name: Pound Cake
description: Historical recipe from The Virginia Housewife; Or, Methodical Cook (1824). Source method; not modernized or kitchen-tested.

instructions.text: Wash the salt from a pound of butter, and rub it till it is soft as cream
Have ready a pound of flour sifted, one of powdered sugar, and twelve eggs well beaten
Put alternately into the butter, sugar, flour, and the froth from the eggs
Continue to beat them together till all the ingredients are in, and the cake quite light
Add some grated lemon peel, a nutmeg, and a gill of brandy

source.author: Mary Randolph
source.originalInstructions:
1. Wash the salt from a pound of butter, and rub it till it is soft as cream
2. Have ready a pound of flour sifted, one of powdered sugar, and twelve eggs well beaten
3. Put alternately into the butter, sugar, flour, and the froth from the eggs
4. Continue to beat them together till all the ingredients are in, and the cake quite light
5. Add some grated lemon peel, a nutmeg, and a gill of brandy
6. Butter the pans
7. Bake them
